notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.notes:
[b]Patch 2.0[/b]

Players are no longer "trapped" within the first 10k digits—you can now explore the entire number Pi.
A new ticket system has been added. Various actions now cost between 1 to 5 tickets, but you can earn tickets by finding the correct digits.
An in-game calculator has been introduced.

[b]Ticket Prices:[/b]

Use the calculator – 1 ticket
Claim a reward for solving – 1 ticket
Use boosters – 3 tickets
Attempt to find a combination – 5 tickets
